partd_prescriber_drug.target_definition: A provider-drug relationship is positive in year t when it is absent from every retained earlier CMS Part D public-use snapshot and observable in the published file for year t.
limitations: Part D labels are published observations subject to suppression and left censoring; CMS suppresses provider-drug combinations with 10 or fewer Part D claims.
The target is not a first prescription, prescribing start, or verified clinical molecule identity.
Brand and generic text are retained as source-native values; no RxNorm or molecule-level merge is asserted.
ClinicalTrials requires historical pre-outcome predictors and is not a legal-compliance target.
FAERS observations are not causal drug-safety labels and may duplicate MAUDE's relational regime.
